q: Which one of the following diseases is characterised by fever in initial days, chronic inflammation in organs and swelling especially in lower limbs?
explanation: Filariasis (Wuchereria bancrofti in the lymph vessels) causes fever early on and then chronic swelling of the lower limbs (elephantiasis). Ascariasis, amoebiasis and TB do not.
